answer: Give each market identity a leased jade licence from a capped, non-transferable pool, renewed per epoch with rent paid into a lagoon fund. A hollow shell that does no verified work earns no rebate, so its rent is pure loss, while an honest agent that completes checked jobs gets most rent back. Cheating revokes the licence and forfeits its deposit, and a replacement costs exponentially more. A sybil farmer must lease and risk a licence per clone, while capped supply pushes prices up as the farm grows; the farm bleeds rent faster than it earns, but one honest agent pays almost nothing net.
